text_block_list.text:
...A short while before the 'Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup.'

A certain piece of news caused ripples 
among the race fans—

—It was the announcement that Mejiro 
McQueen would be entering a long hiatus 
due to leg issues.

The fans who watched her thrive in the 
Spring Senior Triple Crown were greatly 
disappointed by this news—

And we worried over the hoofprints of 
Mejiro McQueen, and where her path would 
lead...—
Meanwhile, as for Ikuno Dictus—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Perhaps I was getting a little ahead of 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...In my desperate desire to grow 
stronger, I tried everything imaginable. I 
even received guidance on various matters 
from Ikuno-san at times—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"We take pride in having achieved in a 
short time what would normally take 
several years of growth. However—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Because of that... I might have pushed my 
body too far.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please do not misunderstand. This was 
strictly my own fault for losing 
self-control in my sheer desperation for 
victory—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I believe it's only thanks 
to Ikuno-san teaching me about management 
and maintenance that it remained this 
minor."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...So, as for me—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —I will not give up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I will return to the turf. No matter how 
long it takes, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Ikuno-san has taught me well enough 
that I can do it too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. McQueen-san will definitely make 
her return.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I will keep running, believing in that.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
So that when you return, we can run 
together once again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I'm already looking forward to that 
day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Please unleash your full strength at the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup, Ikuno-san."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"The sight of you shining out there will 
surely continue to give courage to me and 
many others from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To run in such good health, and for as 
long as my heart desires.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I will definitely prove it out there.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Together with victory, everyone's future.

—And then, the day of the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"—Biometric scan complete. All vitals and 
conditions are optimal. I wish you good 
fortune in battle."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —...Well then, I'll be on my way.

Facing the upcoming battle, Ikuno Dictus 
appears extraordinarily calm, radiating an 
aura of true dignity.

...I've done everything I possibly could 
leading up to today. All that's left is to 
deliver the results...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I'm off to win.
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Ikuno Dictus looks incredibly fired 
up today...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She already feels like a seasoned veteran, 
even though she only just entered the 
Senior Class this year.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—I will make sure our efforts bear fruit 
here.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The power of my experience...!
